steps.title: Analyze User Request and Define App Scope
steps.description: Determined that the user wants to debug or fix errors. Since no source files were supplied, we build a diagnostic/debugger utility to inspect system metrics, check logcats, run permission checks, verify network state, and simulate handled/unhandled exceptions to assist in troubleshooting.

steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Configure the unique application name 'App Debugger & Diagnostic Tool' and the package name 'com.appdebuggerdiagnostictool.app' within app-meta.json.

steps.title: Establish Build Environment Properties
steps.description: Set up build environment matching AGP 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5, target SDK 34, compile SDK 34, and Java 17 toolchain.

steps.title: Configure Application Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml with proper namespace, permissions (Internet, Network State, Read Logs), custom application themes, and launch activity with drawable icon configuration.

steps.title: Design the Main Layout UI
steps.description: Build layout structure using a clean, native TabHost or ScrollView layout with sections for System Info, Live Logs, Network & Storage Diagnostic tests, and a Crash Sandbox.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Initialization
steps.description: Set up the Java 8 class, initialize view components, hook up action buttons, and define clean, native tab or segment navigation.

steps.title: Develop System Information Collector
steps.description: Code custom utility methods to read detailed build information (Android OS version, Model, Manufacturer, Build Fingerprint) and display it formatted in the UI.

steps.title: Implement Live Logcat Reader
steps.description: Write a process executor that runs 'logcat -d', parses recent logs, filters system debug prints, and displays them inside an interactive scrollable console.

steps.title: Add Dynamic Permission & Network Tester
steps.description: Build tests for checking network reachability (DNS / Pings), querying Active Network details, and checking dynamic runtime permission state.

steps.title: Create Storage Test & Crash Sandbox
steps.description: Incorporate local write/read safety test to identify storage read-only errors and custom Crash Handler that intercepts application uncaught exceptions to safely present a debug summary dialog instead of hard-crashing.

steps.title: Conduct Build Readiness Review
steps.description: Validate the Java files against strict Java 8 compatibility, check resource ID matchings, and verify overall manifest compliance.

steps.title: Building App Debugger & Diagnostic Tool
steps.description: Assemble and compile the clean, functional debugging and diagnostic helper application.
